ui_bugs.issue: After logging in as admin and visiting /app/campaigns/3f2ed01a... → ATELIER → SESSIONS, the [data-testid='timeline-panel'] node never rendered in the DOM. The TimelinePanel.jsx code is correct (draggable, handlers, save-hint, PUT /sessions/reorder are all wired exactly as spec'd) and the Reference Editor under ATELIER does mount cleanly on the same page — so the bug is most likely a mount-path issue (TimelinePanel may live behind a different sub-tab / route that wasn't surfaced, OR a conditional gate). All other Atelier sub-tab clicks succeeded; only the Timeline rendering itself was not reachable. Drag-DnD persistence could therefore not be e2e-verified in the live SPA.

critical_code_review_comments: TimelinePanel.jsx (V6.12 drag block, lines 91-134) is correct: HTML5 DnD with effectAllowed='move', proper onDragOver preventDefault gating on (!isGm || sid===dragId), optimistic local reorder before PUT, save-hint timeout 2.5s, defensive try/catch + load() refresh on failure. draggable={isGm} ensures non-GMs cannot drag. Sort logic (lines 49-60) correctly honours sequence_index first and falls back to scheduled_at/played_at/created_at — matches V6.11 backstory/prologue requirement.

ReferenceEditor.jsx KIND_GROUPS constant (lines 83-94) cleanly maps the 22 kinds into the 5 thematic categories with distinct colours (#C8A34A / #7A4FBF / #E03A8E / #3FAA62 / #3F8FAA). Render path (lines 214-240) filters each group's kinds against SYSTEM_KIND_ORDER[systemId] and skips groups with no visible kinds — VERIFIED LIVE on besm-4e: Content & Cypher groups correctly HIDDEN (besm has no spell/feat/background/class_feature/race_trait/cypher kinds in its order), only Mechanics + Bundles + Items_Rules render with 12 total tabs. Active tab gets the matching colour underline via inset box-shadow.

SessionView.jsx chat header (lines 412-444) is correctly responsive: text labels wrapped in `<span className='hidden sm:inline'>` collapse to icon-only at <640px; recap-modal (line 479) uses p-2 sm:p-6; battlemap overlay (line 568) uses p-1 sm:p-3 md:p-6 — all VERIFIED via computed styles at viewport 390 (display:none) vs 1920 (display:block).

Mobile chat-panel header is wrapped with `flex-wrap` so when the screen is narrow, items wrap to next row cleanly; truncation on the title (`truncate` on h1) confirmed visible as 'Ses…' on 390px screenshot.

Cypher group is correctly absent for besm-4e (per spec). Did not verify cypher campaign rendering of the Cypher group — would require switching campaigns. Recommend a quick sanity pass on a Cypher-system campaign to confirm reference-group-cypher renders + reference-group-mechanics is hidden there.
